reason: The quote supports the claim text (operates independently, no performance or availability impact), but the qualifier condition that the Runtime Monitoring security agent is an exception is not in this quote or its context.
Quote states there is no free trial period for Malware Protection On-demand Scanning.
Doc-history rows dated December 20, 2023 (50,000) and June 29, 2023 (10,000) both state a maximum of 5000 members by invitation.
Quotes state lists stop findings from trusted sources and generate findings for known malicious sources, and apply only to traffic to publicly routable IP addresses and domains.
The quote supports pricing on the volume of service logs, events, workloads or data analyzed; 'pay-as-you-go' is only in the surrounding context, not in the quote.
Quote states CloudTrail management event analysis is charged per 1 million events per month and is prorated.
Quote states EKS audit log analysis is charged per 1 million audit logs per month, prorated and discounted with volume.
Quote states VPC Flow Logs and DNS query log analysis is charged per GB per month and discounted with volume.
Quote states charges are based on GB volume of backup data scanned each month, in addition to existing AWS Backup storage costs.
Quotes under 'Malware Protection for EC2' state the charge is on total prorated GB of EBS data scanned each month and that required EBS snapshots are priced separately.
Quote states S3 object scanning costs are based on GB scanned and objects evaluated per month, and required S3 APIs are priced separately.
Quote states the charge is per protected RDS provisioned instance vCPU per month, and ACUs for Aurora Serverless v2.
Quote states Runtime Monitoring pricing is based on number and size of protected workloads, measured in vCPUs.
Quote under the S3 Protection paragraph states CloudTrail S3 data event analysis is charged per 1 million events per month, prorated and discounted with volume.
Quotes state you can enable one or more dedicated protection plans in a supported Region at any time and that they monitor logs and events from other AWS services.
Doc-history row dated March 16, 2023 states RDS Protection GA, profiling RDS login activity to identify suspicious login behavior on Aurora instances.
Quotes state RDS Protection analyzes login and data activity for Aurora and RDS for PostgreSQL, needs no additional infrastructure and is designed not to affect database performance.
Quotes support 'regional service' and a detector ID per Region enabled; that another Region gives a different detector ID is only in the surrounding context, not in a quote.
Quote states automatic agent deployment could add resource utilization and will create VPC endpoints in the VPCs of monitored workloads.
Doc-history row dated March 28, 2024 states GA of Runtime Monitoring for EC2 with an option for GuardDuty to install and manage the agent.
Table row under the header 'Enabled by default with GuardDuty | Separate free trial availability' reads Runtime Monitoring: No | Yes.
The claim is supported, but the display 'GuardDuty doesn't support Amazon EKS clusters' drops the condition 'running on AWS Fargate' and on its own says something false.
Quotes state Runtime Monitoring uses a security agent managed automatically or manually except Fargate (ECS only), and the FAQ says ECS on Fargate must use automated agent configuration.
Quotes state S3 Protection detects risks such as exfiltration and destruction by monitoring CloudTrail S3 data events including object-level API operations in all buckets of the account.
Quotes state GuardDuty does not process unauthenticated requests to publicly accessible objects and processes requests made with valid IAM or STS credentials.
Value line under the heading 'Critical severity' reads 9.0 - 10.0.
Quotes state the 1.0 to 10.0 range is broken into Critical, High, Medium and Low, and critical indicates an attack sequence may be in progress or recently happened.
Value line under the heading 'High severity' reads 7.0 - 8.9.
Value line under the heading 'Low severity' reads 1.0 - 3.9.
Value line under the heading 'Medium severity' reads 4.0 - 6.9.

The quote supports enablement in all accounts, management in the delegated admin (Security Tooling) account and export to the Log Archive bucket beyond 90 days; encryption with a KMS customer managed key is only in the surrounding context.

Quotes support that GuardDuty still generates all findings with an immutable history and that member accounts cannot modify admin rules; 'automatically archive matching findings' is only in the surrounding context.

Quotes support stop monitoring, findings intact, re-enable later and no charge while suspended; the qualifier that Malware Protection for S3 buckets keep incurring cost is not in the quotes or context.
